zh: 腰压住地面，上背和双腿抬离地面
手臂贴着耳朵伸直，双腿并拢伸直。
停住不动，均匀呼吸，别憋气。

cuesEn: Press your lower back down and lift your upper back and legs
Keep your arms straight by your ears and your legs straight together.
Stay still and keep breathing evenly.

actions.nameZh: 平行杆团身 L 撑

zh: 手臂撑直，膝盖抬到胸前
肩膀往下压，别耸肩。
做得稳了，再试着两腿轮流往前伸直。

cuesEn: Lock your arms and pull your knees to your chest
Press your shoulders down, away from your ears.
Once it feels steady, try straightening one leg forward, then the other.

zh: 手臂撑直，卷起肚子把膝盖抬高
膝盖抬到比髋高一点，停一下。
慢慢放下，腿不要甩。

cuesEn: Lock your arms and curl your knees up
Lift your knees a little above your hips and pause.
Lower slowly without swinging your legs.

zh: 蹲向一侧，另一条腿伸直、脚尖朝上
蹲的那只脚脚跟踩住，膝盖对着脚尖。
身体微微前倾，双臂往前平伸保持平衡。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Squat to one side and keep the other leg straight with toes up
Keep the squatting heel down and the knee over the toes.
Lean forward a little and reach your arms forward for balance.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 上面那条腿的膝盖压住凳子，把髋抬起撑住
前臂撑地，手肘在肩膀正下方。
肩、髋、膝成一条直线，撑住别掉，均匀呼吸。

cuesEn: Press your top knee into the bench, lift your hips and hold
Rest on your forearm with the elbow under your shoulder.
Keep your shoulder, hip, and knee in one line, hold it there, and keep breathing.

zh: 腿伸直，往里扫到支撑腿前面
侧对器械站，靠近器械的脚踝套上绑带。
骨盆放平，慢慢放回外侧。

cuesEn: Keep the leg straight and sweep it in front of the standing leg
Stand side-on to the machine with the strap on the near ankle.
Keep your hips level and let the leg back out slowly.

zh: 做一个俯卧撑，再整个人转向侧面
胸口和髋一起转，别只扭腰。
上面的手伸向天花板，停一下再转回来。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Do a push-up, then turn your whole body to the side
Turn your chest and hips together, not just your waist.
Reach your top arm to the ceiling, pause, then turn back.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 胸口沉到两手之间，手肘斜向后
推起后手臂伸直，再把地往下推远一点。
身体保持一条直线，别塌腰。

cuesEn: Sink your chest between your hands with elbows angled back
At the top, straighten your arms and push the floor a little further away.
Keep your body in one straight line without sagging.

zh: 前后脚站稳，一只手往前推到伸直
推的时候肩和髋都朝前，别跟着转。
收回时放慢，别让绳子把手拉回去。
换另一只手时，前后脚也换过来。

cuesEn: Stand with one foot forward and press one arm straight out
Keep your shoulders and hips facing forward as you press.
Return slowly and do not let the cable pull your hand back.
When you switch arms, switch your front foot too.

zh: 手撑在肩膀正下方，把地推远
髋慢慢往下沉，再抬回身体成一条直线。
另一只手放在髋上，肩和脚不动。

cuesEn: Keep your hand under your shoulder and push the floor away
Lower your hips slowly, then lift back into one straight line.
Rest your other hand on your hip and keep your shoulders and feet still.

zh: 举哑铃的手一直指向天花板
先撑到手肘，再撑手坐起，最后抬髋到高桥。
每一步稳住再走下一步，原路回去。

cuesEn: Keep the dumbbell arm pointing straight at the ceiling
Roll onto your elbow, press up to sitting, then lift your hips into a high bridge.
Settle each step before the next, then go back the same way.

zh: 斜着往前上方推，直到手臂伸直
收紧臀部和肚子，上身别往后仰。
慢慢放回肩膀前面。

cuesEn: Press up and forward until your arm is straight
Squeeze your glutes and belly and keep your trunk from leaning back.
Lower slowly back to the front of your shoulder.

zh: 手推地把髋抬起，身体成一条直线
双手在肩膀下面，手指朝脚的方向。
手臂伸直，脚跟踩地，顶上夹紧臀部。

cuesEn: Push the floor away and lift your hips into one straight line
Keep your hands under your shoulders with fingers toward your feet.
Keep your arms straight, heels down, and squeeze your glutes at the top.

zh: 髋压在球上，抬到身体成一条直线就停
双脚抵住墙根，腿伸直。
顶上停一秒，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: With hips on the ball, lift only until your body is straight
Brace your feet against the wall with legs straight.
Pause for a second at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 从髋部往下弯，背保持平直
垫子顶在髋骨下面，双手交叉放胸前。
抬到身体成一条直线就停，别再往后仰。

cuesEn: Bend down from your hips and keep your back flat
Set the pad just below your hip bones and cross your arms on your chest.
Stop when your body is straight, without leaning back further.

zh: 身体前后轻轻摇，力度由轻到重
指尖朝前、朝外、朝后、手背贴地，每个手位摇 4 次再换。
往前再往后摇一下算 1 次，手臂伸直、膝盖跪稳。

cuesEn: Rock your weight forward and back, starting light
Fingers forward, out, back, then backs of the hands: rock 4 times in each position.
One rock forward and back counts as one. Keep your arms straight and knees steady.

zh: 前臂平放在大腿上，只动手腕
手腕往上卷，再慢慢往下放到底。
往上约 1 秒，往下约 2 秒。

cuesEn: Rest your forearm on your thigh and move only your wrist
Curl your wrist up, then lower it slowly all the way down.
Take about one second up and two seconds down.

zh: 壶铃底朝上，前臂竖直，手腕别弯
握紧把手，手肘在肩膀前下方。
慢慢走，身体站直。

cuesEn: Hold the kettlebell upside down with your forearm upright
Grip the handle tight with your elbow in front of and below your shoulder.
Walk slowly and stay tall.

zh: 腿往外侧抬，骨盆和上身不动
一只手扶稳椅子，支撑脚踩实。
慢慢放回，别让绳子拉回去。

cuesEn: Lift your leg out to the side and keep your hips and trunk still
Hold a stable chair with one hand and keep the standing foot planted.
Return slowly and do not let the cable pull the leg back.

zh: 用臀部把腿往后推，上身不动
一只手扶稳椅子，支撑脚踩实。
腰别往后仰，慢慢放回。

cuesEn: Push your leg back with your glutes and keep your trunk still
Hold a stable chair with one hand and keep the standing foot planted.
Do not arch your lower back, and return slowly.

zh: 一条腿伸直抬起，用臀部把髋推高
支撑脚踩稳，骨盆别歪。
慢慢放回，别用腰往上顶。

cuesEn: Lift one leg straight and drive your hips up with your glutes
Keep the standing foot planted and your hips level.
Lower slowly and do not push up with your lower back.

zh: 跪撑在垫上，腿伸直往后上方抬
腰别塌，抬到和身体差不多高就好。
顶上停一秒，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: On hands and knees, lift your straight leg back and up
Keep your lower back from sagging, and lift only to about body height.
Pause for a second at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 用臀部把双腿抬到和上身一样高
上身趴在垫子上，握紧把手，双腿伸直。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Use your glutes to lift your legs level with your upper body
Lie on the pad, grip the handles, and keep your legs straight.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 坐直，后腿膝盖贴地，把小腿和脚抬起
前腿小腿横在身前，双手放在膝盖上。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Sit tall, keep your back knee down, and lift that shin and foot
Keep your front shin across your body and your hands on your knees.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 背保持平直，臀部往后坐向脚跟
一条腿往侧面伸直，整只脚踩地，脚尖朝前。
大腿内侧有拉伸感时停一下，再往前回。

cuesEn: Keep your back flat and sit your hips back toward your heel
Reach one leg straight out to the side, foot flat and toes forward.
Pause when you feel the inner thigh stretch, then rock forward.

zh: 手脚一起移向一侧，身体弯成香蕉形
双肩和臀部一直贴着垫子。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Move your hands and feet to one side so your body curves
Keep both shoulders and your hips on the mat.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 手肘贴住身体，双手弯向肩膀
双脚踩住弹力带中间，掌心朝前。
放下时慢一点，直到手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Keep your elbows at your sides and curl your hands up
Stand on the middle of the band with your palms facing forward.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

zh: 肘微弯不动，手臂往身前合拢
弹力带固定在身后外侧，和胸口一样高。
合拢后停一下，再慢慢打开，手别到身体后面。

cuesEn: Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across
Anchor the band behind you and out to the side, at chest height.
Pause, then open slowly without letting the arm go behind you.

zh: 把弹力带拉向脸，手肘抬高往两边
肩胛骨往后夹，不耸肩。
慢慢放回，直到手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Pull the band to your face with your elbows high and wide
Squeeze your shoulder blades back without shrugging.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

zh: 用臀部把腿往后推，身体不动
弹力带固定在前方低处，椅子只用来扶稳。
腰别往后弯，慢慢放回。

cuesEn: Use your glutes to push the leg back and keep your body still
Anchor the band low in front of you; use the chair only for balance.
Keep your lower back from arching and return slowly.

zh: 膝盖不动，脚往外侧摆开
坐直，大腿贴住椅面，双手放在大腿上。
外面停一下，再慢慢收回。

cuesEn: Keep your knee still and swing your foot out
Sit tall with your thigh on the seat and your hands on your thighs.
Pause out there, then bring it back slowly.

actions.nameZh: 仰卧弹力带单腿向外落

zh: 膝盖伸直，腿慢慢往外侧落
用手拉住弹力带，让带子托住腿的重量。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Keep your knee straight and slowly lower the leg out
Hold the band so it takes the weight of your leg.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 双手往前推直，身体别被拉转
侧对固定点站直，膝盖微弯。
推直后停两秒，再收回胸前。

cuesEn: Press your hands straight out and do not let your body turn
Stand tall side-on to the anchor with soft knees.
Hold for two seconds, then bring your hands back to your chest.

zh: 手臂伸直，把弹力带拉开成 T 字
肩胛骨往后、往下夹。
肋骨别往外顶，慢慢收回。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and pull the band apart into a T
Squeeze your shoulder blades back and down.
Keep your ribs down and return slowly.

zh: 手肘贴着身体往后拉
坐直，腿伸直，弹力带套住双脚。
拉到底夹一下肩胛骨，再慢慢伸直手臂。

cuesEn: Pull your elbows back close to your sides
Sit tall with your legs straight and the band around your feet.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end, then slowly straighten your arms.

zh: 手肘贴身弯成直角，小臂往肚子转
侧对固定点站直，膝盖微弯。
停一下，再慢慢转回去。

cuesEn: Keep your elbow bent at your side and turn your forearm in to your belly
Stand tall side-on to the anchor with soft knees.
Pause, then turn back slowly.

zh: 腿往侧面抬，上身保持不动
弹力带固定在牢固的低处，椅子只用来扶稳。
慢慢放回，在不疼的范围里做。

cuesEn: Lift the leg out to the side and keep your upper body still
Anchor the band to a secure low post; use the chair only for balance.
Return slowly and stay in a pain-free range.

zh: 腿伸直，往里并向支撑腿
弹力带固定在牢固的低处，椅子只用来扶稳。
慢慢放回，骨盆别歪。

cuesEn: Keep the leg straight and pull it in toward the standing leg
Anchor the band to a secure low post; use the chair only for balance.
Return slowly and keep your hips level.

zh: 手臂伸直在胸前，身体一直朝前
两只脚一只一只往外迈，再一只一只收回。
膝盖微弯，保持呼吸。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight in front and your body facing forward
Step your feet out one at a time, then back in one at a time.
Keep your knees soft and keep breathing.

zh: 膝盖微弯不动，腿往前抬
上身别往后仰，椅子只用来扶稳。
慢慢放回，膝盖别绷死。

cuesEn: Keep your knee slightly bent and lift the leg forward
Keep your upper body from leaning back; use the chair only for balance.
Lower slowly without locking your knee.

zh: 大臂贴住身体，只把手往下压直
身体别前倾，肩膀别晃。
压直后停一下，再慢慢放回。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arm at your side and press your hand down
Keep your body upright and your shoulder still.
Pause with your arm straight, then return slowly.

zh: 收紧肚子，膝盖离地一点点
手在肩膀下，膝盖在臀部下，脚尖踩地。
背放平，臀部别翘高，撑住均匀呼吸。

cuesEn: Tighten your belly and lift your knees just off the floor
Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, toes tucked.
Keep your back flat and hips level, and keep breathing as you hold.

zh: 膝盖一直弯着，踮起脚跟
双手叉腰，身体挺直。
慢慢放下脚跟，膝盖弯度不变。

cuesEn: Keep your knees bent and rise onto the balls of your feet
Rest your hands on your hips and stand tall.
Lower your heels slowly without changing your knee bend.

zh: 另一只手压住小臂，顶着它慢慢弯起
手肘贴住身体，掌心朝上。
放下时也要用力顶住，别松劲。

cuesEn: Press on your forearm with the other hand and curl slowly against it
Keep your elbow at your side, palm up.
Keep pushing back as you lower; do not relax.

zh: 双手握紧哑铃垂在身侧，站直
肩膀往下沉，胸口打开。
均匀呼吸，膝盖别绷死。

cuesEn: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and stand tall
Draw your shoulders down and keep your chest open.
Breathe evenly and keep your knees slightly soft.

zh: 双臂往前环抱，上背往后拱
肩胛骨往两边分开，低头放松脖子。
保持呼吸，每次呼气再抱紧一点。

cuesEn: Wrap your arms forward and round your upper back
Spread your shoulder blades apart and relax your neck.
Keep breathing and hug a little tighter each time you breathe out.

zh: 臀部撑住不掉，两只脚轮流抬起
夹紧臀部，骨盆保持水平。
脚轻轻放回地面，再换另一只。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep your hips up and lift one foot at a time
Squeeze your glutes and keep your hips level.
Set the foot down softly, then switch feet.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 手臂贴地伸过头，夹臀把髋抬起
仰卧屈膝，双脚与髋同宽。
肋骨往下收，停住再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your arms long overhead on the floor and squeeze your glutes to lift
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your ribs down, hold at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 身体垂直往下沉，前膝对着脚尖
后脚脚背搭在椅面，前脚跟踩稳。
下到前大腿差不多和地面平，再用前脚跟推起。

cuesEn: Lower straight down and keep your front knee over your toes
Rest the top of your back foot on the seat and keep your front heel down.
Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, then push up through your front heel.

zh: 脚掌相对，膝盖慢慢往两边打开
打开到舒服的程度停一下。
用大腿内侧把膝盖收回，脚别滑。

cuesEn: With your soles together, slowly lower your knees out to the sides
Open only as far as is comfortable, then pause.
Use your inner thighs to bring your knees back up without your feet sliding.

zh: 脚跟直直抬起，脚踝别往外翻
指尖轻扶墙，只用来保持平衡。
膝盖伸直，身体像一根直线往上走。

cuesEn: Rise straight up onto the balls of your feet
Rest your fingertips on the wall for balance only.
Keep your knees straight and rise as one straight line.

zh: 先拱背低头，再抬胸塌腰
双手在肩膀正下方，膝盖在髋正下方，手和膝盖不动。
头跟着身体自然动，别甩头。
拱背再抬胸算 1 次。

cuesEn: Round your back, then lift your chest and let your belly sink
Keep your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, and keep them still.
Let your head follow your body without throwing it.
Rounding up and lifting your chest counts as one.

zh: 手肘直直往后弯，肩膀别耸
双手撑在椅面前沿，膝盖弯着，双脚踩地。
下到大臂差不多和地面平，再撑回手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Bend your elbows straight back and keep your shoulders down
Put your hands on the front edge of the seat, knees bent and feet flat.
Lower until your upper arms are about level, then push back up to straight arms.

actions.nameZh: 扶椅屈肘手臂后侧拉伸

zh: 手肘搭稳椅背，臀部往后让胸口下沉
双肘弯着，手放在后颈附近，别碰头。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Rest your elbows on the chair, push your hips back, and let your chest sink
Keep your elbows bent with your hands near the back of your neck, not touching your head.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 夹紧臀部把腿往后抬，腰别往后仰
双手扶椅背，上身稍微前倾。
骨盆别歪，脚放回到支撑脚旁边。

cuesEn: Squeeze your glute to lift the leg back without arching your back
Hold the chair back with both hands and lean slightly forward.
Keep your hips level and bring the foot back beside your standing foot.

zh: 臀部往后推，胸口在两臂之间下沉
双手扶椅背，手臂伸直，膝盖微弯。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Push your hips back and let your chest sink between your arms
Hands on the chair back, arms straight, knees slightly bent.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 一手轻扶椅子，前后腿慢慢滑开
只滑到能控制的地方，髋部朝前。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Hold the chair lightly and slowly slide your legs apart
Slide only as far as you can control, hips facing forward.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 一只脚踩地发力，把臀部抬到身体放平
上背靠在椅面边上，另一条腿收起。
骨盆别往一边掉，顶上夹紧臀部。

cuesEn: Drive through one foot to lift your hips until your body is level
Rest your upper back on the seat edge and keep the other knee tucked.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes at the top.

zh: 上身前倾，双脚踩实站起来
双臂往前伸，帮助保持平衡。
坐回去时慢慢来，别一屁股坐下。

cuesEn: Lean forward and push through both feet to stand up
Reach your arms forward to help your balance.
Sit back down slowly instead of dropping.

zh: 整只脚踩上椅面，用这条腿发力站上去
两条腿轮流先上，双手叉腰。
下来时另一只脚先落地，慢慢下。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Plant your whole foot on the seat and stand up with that leg
Switch the leading leg each rep, hands on your hips.
On the way down, lower the other foot first, slowly.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 臀部在膝盖正上方，胸口在两臂之间下沉
双手平放椅面，手臂伸直。
腰别往下塌，停住呼吸再抬回平背。

cuesEn: Keep your hips over your knees and sink your chest between your arms
Place your hands flat on the seat with straight arms.
Keep your lower back from sagging, breathe, then lift back to a flat back.

zh: 双脚并拢膝盖微弯，从髋部往前折
手臂自然垂下，不用硬去够地。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Feet together, knees soft, fold forward from your hips
Let your arms hang. No need to reach the floor.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 双手轻推地，胸口慢慢抬起
髋和大腿贴着垫子，肩膀往下放。
停住呼吸，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Press gently through your hands and slowly lift your chest
Keep your hips and thighs on the mat and your shoulders down.
Stay and breathe, then lower slowly.

zh: 上身挺直，收紧臀部把髋往前送
后脚脚背搭在矮凳上，前脚踩稳，双手叉腰。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Stay tall, squeeze your glutes, and ease your hips forward
Rest the top of your back foot on the stool, front foot planted, hands on hips.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 手臂横过胸前，另一手把它拉近
另一手按在肘关节上方，肩膀往下放别耸。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Bring your arm across your chest and pull it in with the other hand
Hold just above the elbow and keep your shoulder down.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 把上身卷起来，肩胛骨离开垫子
下背贴着垫子，双手沿大腿伸向膝盖。
停一下，再一节一节慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Curl up until your shoulder blades leave the mat
Keep your lower back down and reach your hands toward your knees.
Pause, then roll down slowly.

zh: 脚跟直直抬起，踮到最高
双手拿哑铃垂在身体两侧，身体站直。
脚踝别往外翻，慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Rise straight up onto the balls of your feet
Hold the dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Keep your ankles from rolling out and lower slowly.

zh: 大臂贴住身体，只动小臂
左右轮流弯，往上时掌心慢慢转向上。
放下时慢一点，身体别晃。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arms by your sides and move only your forearms
Alternate arms, turning your palm up as you curl.
Lower slowly and keep your body still.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 手肘微弯别动，两臂往两边打开再合拢
仰卧屈膝，双脚踩地，哑铃从胸口上方开始。
大臂轻碰地面就停，不要弹起来。

cuesEn: Keep your elbows softly bent and open your arms wide, then bring them together
Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, dumbbells above your chest.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor, without bouncing.

zh: 慢慢放到大臂碰地，再推回肩膀上方
手腕在手肘正上方，大臂和身体斜着约 45 度。
碰地轻停，不要弹起来。

cuesEn: Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up over your shoulders
Keep your wrists over your elbows and your upper arms angled out at about 45 degrees.
Pause lightly at the floor without bouncing.

zh: 手肘微弯别动，双臂往前抬到肩高
身体别往后仰，腿不借力。
慢慢放下，控制住重量。

cuesEn: Keep your elbows softly bent and raise your arms forward to shoulder height
Do not lean back or use your legs.
Lower slowly and control the weight.

zh: 掌心一直相对，大臂不动只弯手肘
身体站直，别前后晃。

cuesEn: Keep your palms facing each other and bend only at the elbows
Stand tall without swinging.

zh: 大臂贴住身体不动，把小臂往后伸直
身体前倾，背保持平直，膝盖微弯。
伸直后停一下，再慢慢弯回来。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arms still and straighten your arms back
Lean forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Pause with your arms straight, then bend back slowly.

zh: 手肘微弯别动，双臂往两边抬到肩高
肩膀往下放，别耸肩。
慢慢放下，身体别晃。

cuesEn: Keep your elbows softly bent and raise your arms out to shoulder height
Keep your shoulders down without shrugging.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

zh: 手臂伸直举过头，肩膀往耳朵耸
站直，肋骨往下收，头不动。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Hold your arms straight overhead and shrug your shoulders toward your ears
Stand tall with your ribs down and your head still.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 大臂贴着耳朵不动，只用小臂把哑铃举直
哑铃从头后面向上举到手臂伸直。
慢慢放回头后，在底部停一会儿再举。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arm by your ear and straighten only the forearm
Lift the dumbbell from behind your head until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly behind your head and pause at the bottom before the next one.

zh: 从耳朵高度往上推，推到手臂快伸直
手肘在手腕正下方，稍微在身体前面。
肋骨往下收，身体不后仰。

cuesEn: Press up from ear height until your arms are almost straight
Keep your elbows under your wrists and a little in front of your body.
Keep your ribs down and do not lean back.

zh: 臀部往后推，背保持平直，哑铃贴腿下放
膝盖微弯，但不要往下蹲。
哑铃到膝盖下方、大腿后侧有拉伸感就停，再站直。

cuesEn: Push your hips back with a flat back and slide the weights down your legs
Keep your knees soft without squatting.
Stop just below the knees when the backs of your thighs stretch, then stand tall.

zh: 手背朝前握哑铃，手肘贴身往上弯
手腕保持平直，不要往下折。
举到胸口高度停一下。

cuesEn: Hold the dumbbells palms down and curl up with elbows at your sides
Keep your wrists straight, not bent down.
Pause at chest height.

zh: 身体前倾背平直，双臂往两边打开到和背齐平
手肘微弯不变，肩胛骨往中间夹。
不耸肩不甩，慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Lean forward with a flat back and open your arms level with your back
Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Do not shrug or swing, and lower slowly.

zh: 手肘贴着身体往上往后拉，哑铃拉到肋骨旁
一只手撑在椅面上，背保持平直不扭。
肩胛骨往后夹，停一下再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Pull your elbow up and back until the dumbbell reaches your ribs
Rest one hand on the seat and keep your back flat and square.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, pause, then lower slowly.

zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀直直往耳朵方向耸
不弯手肘、不转肩、脖子不动。
顶端停一下。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and lift your shoulders toward your ears
Do not bend your elbows, roll your shoulders or move your neck.
Pause at the top.

zh: 双脚前后站定不动，身体直直往下沉
前脚整只踩地，前膝对着脚尖。
用前脚推地站起，上身挺直。

cuesEn: Stay in your split stance and lower straight down
Keep your whole front foot down and your front knee over your toes.
Push through your front foot to rise, keeping your chest tall.

zh: 一手扶墙一手拿哑铃，踮起脚跟
身体站直，脚踝不往外翻。
顶端停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Hold the wall with one hand and a dumbbell in the other, then rise up
Stand tall and keep your ankles from rolling out.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 掌心朝上举起，顶端翻成掌心朝下再放
手肘贴住身体，手腕平直。
放到底再把掌心翻回朝上。

cuesEn: Curl up palms up, turn them down at the top, then lower
Keep your elbows at your sides and wrists straight.
At the bottom, turn your palms back up.

zh: 手臂伸直，胸口往大腿方向压
臀部推高，背拉长，脚跟往地面落。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and press your chest toward your thighs
Push your hips high, keep your back long and reach your heels down.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 膝盖弯成直角，脚底往天花板推
双手和支撑的膝盖稳住，身体不动。
腰不往下塌，慢慢放回。

cuesEn: Keep your knee bent at a right angle and push your sole up
Keep your hands and supporting knee steady and your body still.
Keep your lower back from sagging and lower slowly.

zh: 双前臂贴住门框，身体慢慢往前穿过门口
前后脚站稳，脚不动。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Forearms on the doorframe, slowly lean through the doorway
Keep your feet planted in a split stance.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 双手握杠，弯手肘把身体往上拉
只拉到舒服的高度，肩膀别耸向耳朵。
慢慢放下到手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Grip the bar and bend your elbows to pull yourself up
Pull only as high as is comfortable, keeping your shoulders down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

actions.nameEn: Kneeling Nordic Curl with Hand Push-Back

zh: 跪姿固定脚跟，身体一条直线慢慢往前倒
用大腿后侧控制往下的速度。
倒到底双手撑地，屁股往后坐再推回跪直。

cuesEn: Kneel with heels anchored and fall forward slowly in one line
Use the backs of your thighs to control the speed.
Catch yourself with your hands, sit your hips back and push back up to kneeling.

zh: 手肘在肩膀正下方，从头到脚跟一条直线
收紧臀部和肚子，屁股不高不低。
均匀呼吸，不要憋气。

cuesEn: Elbows under shoulders, body in one line from head to heels
Squeeze your glutes and abs, hips neither high nor low.
Breathe evenly and do not hold your breath.

zh: 向前跨一步，身体直直往下沉
前膝对着脚尖，前脚跟踩实。
前脚推地退回站立，换另一条腿。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Step forward and lower straight down
Keep your front knee over your toes and your front heel down.
Push off your front foot to step back, then switch legs.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 壶铃抱在胸前，臀部往后往下坐
膝盖对着脚尖，脚跟踩地。
胸口保持抬起，壶铃贴身。

cuesEn: Hold the kettlebell at your chest and sit down and back
Keep your knees over your toes and your heels down.
Keep your chest up and the bell close to your body.

zh: 臀部往后推，上身像木板一样往前倾
双手交叉放胸前，膝盖微弯。
上身接近水平、大腿后侧有拉伸感就停。

cuesEn: Push your hips back and tip forward like a flat board
Cross your hands on your chest and keep your knees soft.
Stop when your trunk is nearly level and the backs of your thighs stretch.

actions.nameZh: 半跪手拉脚大腿前侧拉伸

zh: 手拉后脚靠近臀部，髋轻轻往前送
后膝跪在垫上，前脚踩地，另一只手扶髋。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Pull your back foot toward your glutes and ease your hips forward
Back knee on the mat, front foot down, other hand on your hip.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 膝盖抬到髋的高度，往外画一圈再放下
一手扶椅背，骨盆和上身朝前不转。
画一圈算 1 次，下一次反方向画回来。

cuesEn: Lift your knee to hip height, circle it out, then lower
Hold the chair back and keep your hips and chest facing forward.
One circle counts as one. Circle back the other way on the next one.

zh: 身体一条直线，胸口往凳边放下
手肘斜向后，不要往两边张。
推回到手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Keep your body in one line and lower your chest to the edge
Angle your elbows back, not out to the sides.
Press back up to straight arms.

zh: 下面的腿伸直，夹紧大腿内侧往上抬
侧躺用前臂撑地，上面的脚踩在下面膝盖前。
顶端停一下，放下时不砸地。

cuesEn: Keep the bottom leg straight and squeeze your inner thigh to lift
Lie on your side on one forearm with the top foot planted in front of the bottom knee.
Pause at the top and lower without dropping.

zh: 髋部猛地往前推，让手臂把壶铃荡起来
背保持平直，臀部往后推，壶铃荡到两腿之间。
顶端站直夹臀，身体不后仰。

cuesEn: Snap your hips forward and let your arm float the bell up
Keep your back flat and push your hips back as the bell swings between your legs.
Stand tall at the top with glutes tight, without leaning back.

zh: 双手抱住膝盖，轻轻拉向胸口
头和肩放松贴地。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Hug your knees and gently pull them toward your chest
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 前脚跟踩住地，膝盖往前碰墙
膝盖朝第二、三个脚趾的方向走。
双手自然垂在身体两侧，身体跟着膝盖往前。

cuesEn: Keep your front heel down and push your knee forward to the wall
Point your knee over your second and third toes.
Let your arms hang and let your body follow your knee.

zh: 脚背贴地跪好，身体慢慢往后坐
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Kneel with the tops of your feet down and slowly sit back
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 膝盖着地，从头到膝一条直线往下
手肘斜着往后，别往两边张开。
撑回到手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Kneel and lower with your body straight from head to knees
Bend your elbows back at an angle, not out to the sides.
Push back up to straight arms.

zh: 一只手掌心朝上，从另一只手臂下面穿过去
穿过去的肩膀往下沉，上背跟着转。
屁股留在膝盖正上方不动。

cuesEn: Slide one hand palm-up under your other arm
Let that shoulder sink as your upper back turns.
Keep your hips over your knees.

zh: 往旁边跨一步，屁股往后坐到这条腿上
另一条腿伸直，两只脚尖朝前。
跨出的脚推地回到站立，再换另一边。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Step out to the side and sit your hips back over that leg
Keep the other leg straight and both toes pointing forward.
Push off the stepping foot to stand, then switch sides.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 膝盖慢慢收向胸口，屁股别翘高
手在肩膀正下方，身体一条直线。
两条腿轮流收，每次停一下再踩回。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Slowly bring your knee toward your chest without lifting your hips
Keep your hands under your shoulders and your body in one line.
Switch legs each time, pausing before you step back.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双膝并拢，上面的手臂画个大弧往后打开
侧躺，头枕垫子，髋和膝盖都弯成直角。
眼睛跟着手走。

cuesEn: Keep your knees together and sweep your top arm back in a big arc
Lie on your side, head on a cushion, hips and knees bent at right angles.
Follow your hand with your eyes.

actions.nameZh: 站姿过头手臂后侧拉伸

zh: 一只手举过头弯肘，另一只手轻推手肘
身体站直，头别往前探。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Raise one arm, bend the elbow, and gently push it with your other hand
Stand tall and keep your head back.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 屁股保持高，弯肘让头落到双手前面
身体成倒 V 字，双手与肩同宽，腿伸直。
手肘斜着往后弯，再撑回手臂伸直。

cuesEn: Keep your hips high and bend your elbows to lower your head in front of your hands
Make an upside-down V with hands shoulder-width apart and legs straight.
Bend your elbows back at an angle, then push back to straight arms.

zh: 手臂伸直，把肩膀推向耳朵再放下
身体成倒 V 字，手肘一直不弯。
动作慢、幅度小。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and push your shoulders toward your ears, then lower
Hold an upside-down V and keep your elbows straight the whole time.
Move slowly with a small range.

actions.nameEn: High Plank Alternating Side Toe Tap

zh: 高位平板，一只脚往旁边点地再收回
屁股朝着地面，不左右晃。
双手不动，两只脚轮流点。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: From a high plank, tap one foot out to the side and back
Keep your hips facing the floor without swaying.
Keep your hands still and switch feet each time.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 膝盖抬起，画一个你能做到的最大的圈
屁股和背不动，只有腿在转。
画一圈算 1 次，下一圈反方向。

cuesEn: Lift your knee and draw the biggest circle you can
Keep your hips and back still; only the leg moves.
One circle counts as one. Go the other way on the next one.

zh: 一只手撑地，另一只手臂朝天花板打开
眼睛跟着手，胸口转开。
屁股不动。

cuesEn: Keep one hand down and open your other arm toward the ceiling
Follow your hand with your eyes and turn your chest open.
Keep your hips still.

zh: 背保持平直，屁股往脚跟方向坐
双手不动，手臂伸直。
背快要弯的时候就停住，再往前回。

cuesEn: Keep your back flat and rock your hips back toward your heels
Keep your hands planted and your arms straight.
Stop just before your back starts to round, then rock forward.

zh: 双膝并拢，上面的脚往上抬离下面的脚
屁股别往后翻。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your knees together and lift your top foot away from the bottom one
Keep your hips from rolling back.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 用下腹把屁股卷离垫子，膝盖靠向胸口
双手压地，上背贴住垫子。
慢慢放回，脚别掉下去。

cuesEn: Use your lower abs to curl your hips up so your knees come toward your chest
Press your palms down and keep your upper back on the mat.
Lower slowly without letting your feet drop.

zh: 往后退一步，两腿弯到后膝快碰地
前膝在脚踝正上方，上身直立稍前倾。
前脚跟推地站起，后脚收回，再换另一条腿。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Step back and bend both knees until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Keep the front knee over the ankle and your body tall with a slight lean.
Push through the front heel to stand, bring the back foot in, then switch legs.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 上身后仰背挺直，胸口慢慢转向一边
膝盖和屁股朝前不动，脚跟踩地。
回到中间，再转向另一边。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Lean back with a long back and slowly turn your chest to one side
Keep your knees and hips facing forward and your heels down.
Come back to the middle, then turn to the other side.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双手撑在身后不动，屁股慢慢往前滑
手指朝后，手臂伸直，胸口抬起。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Keep your hands planted behind you and slowly slide your hips forward
Fingers point back, arms straight, chest up.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 前臂和膝盖撑地，屁股抬起成一条直线
手肘在肩膀正下方，用力推地。
正常呼吸，屁股别往下掉。

cuesEn: Prop on your forearm and knee and lift your hips into a straight line
Keep your elbow under your shoulder and push the floor away.
Breathe normally and do not let your hips drop.

zh: 手肘贴住身体，小臂往上往外转
手肘下面可以垫条毛巾，身体别往后翻。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your elbow at your side and turn your forearm up and out
Put a rolled towel under your elbow and keep your body from rolling back.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 腿伸直往旁边抬，脚尖朝前
双手扶腰，上身别往另一边倒。
顶上停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Lift your straight leg out to the side with your toes forward
Keep your hands on your hips and do not lean the other way.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 双手撑住不动，两只脚一起往后滑再收回
手肘和膝盖基本伸直，身体整体一起动。
只滑到能控制的距离，腰别塌。

cuesEn: Keep your hands planted and slide both feet back, then pull them in
Keep your elbows and knees nearly straight and move your body as one piece.
Slide only as far as you can control without letting your back sag.

zh: 屁股往后坐，膝盖对着脚尖
脚跟一直踩地，胸口抬起。
蹲到大腿差不多和地面平，再推地站起。

cuesEn: Sit your hips back and keep your knees over your toes
Keep your heels down and your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about level, then push through your feet to stand.

zh: 手臂伸直，慢慢往后抬
站直，膝盖微弯，肩胛骨轻轻往后往下收。
上身别往前倾，停一下再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and slowly lift them back
Stand tall with soft knees and gently draw your shoulder blades back and down.
Keep your upper body upright, pause, then lower slowly.

zh: 大臂不动，掌心转向上，再转向下
手肘弯着贴在身侧，手腕不弯。
转到一头算 1 次，每到头停一下，慢慢转。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arm still and turn your palm up, then down
Keep your elbow bent at your side and your wrist straight.
Each turn to one end counts as one. Pause at each end and turn slowly.

zh: 掌心朝下，手腕先往拇指侧摆，再往小指侧摆
手肘弯着不动，前臂不转。
摆到一侧算 1 次，慢而轻，不要硬掰。

cuesEn: Palm down, tilt your hand to the thumb side, then the pinky side
Keep your elbow bent and still and your forearm from turning.
Each tilt to one side counts as one. Move slowly and gently.

zh: 手臂伸向前方，掌心朝下，手腕慢慢往下弯
手肘伸直但不锁死，不用另一只手压。
肩膀放松，每次停一下再慢慢放松手腕。

cuesEn: Reach your arm forward palm down and slowly bend your wrist down
Keep your elbow straight but soft, without pressing with the other hand.
Keep your shoulder relaxed, pause, then slowly let the wrist come back up.

zh: 一只脚往旁边迈，双臂同时举过头顶
脚尖先落地再踩平。
收脚放下手臂，下一次换另一只脚。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Step one foot out as both arms sweep overhead
Land on your toes, then set the foot flat.
Step back in as your arms come down, then switch feet.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双手握杠，手臂伸直，身体自然挂着
身体保持不动，不要晃。
快握不住前先踩稳再松手。

cuesEn: Grip the bar with straight arms and let your body hang
Keep your body still without swinging.
Step down safely before your grip gives out.

zh: 一手提哑铃站直，身体不往任何一边歪
两边肩膀一样高，正常呼吸。
时间到后慢慢放下，换手再做。

cuesEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand tall without leaning
Keep your shoulders level and breathe normally.
Set it down slowly, then switch hands.

zh: 一手提哑铃，两腿轮流抬膝，骨盆别歪
上身挺直，不往一边歪。
膝盖不用抬太高，先把重心移到支撑脚再抬。
两边各抬一次算 1 次，下一组换手提。

cuesEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and march without tipping your hips
Keep your upper body tall without leaning.
Lift your knee only a little, after shifting onto the standing foot.
One lift on each side counts as one rep. Switch hands next set.

actions.nameEn: Sumo Squat Hold with Elbow Pry

zh: 双手合掌，用手肘把膝盖往外推
两脚站宽、脚尖朝外，脚跟踩实。
胸口挺起，蹲住停一下再站起。

cuesEn: Press your palms together and push your knees out with your elbows
Stand wide with toes turned out and heels down.
Keep your chest up, pause low, then rise.

zh: 手臂、胸口和双腿一起抬离垫子
肚子贴着垫子，眼睛看垫子。
顶端停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Lift your arms, chest and legs off the mat together
Keep your belly on the mat and your eyes down.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 两腿伸直一起抬起，腰贴住垫子
头、上背和屁股贴着垫子。
慢慢放下，腰不拱起来。

cuesEn: Lift both straight legs together with your lower back down
Keep your head, upper back and hips on the mat.
Lower slowly without arching your back.

zh: 手肘和手背贴地，双臂沿地面往头的方向滑
仰躺屈膝，双脚踩地，腰放松。
有轻微拉伸感就停住，再慢慢滑回。

cuesEn: Keep elbows and hands on the floor and slide your arms toward your head
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, lower back relaxed.
Stop at a mild stretch, then slide back down slowly.

zh: 脚跟贴着地面慢慢滑远，再滑回来
腰贴住垫子，骨盆不动。
另一只脚踩稳地面。

cuesEn: Slide your heel slowly away along the floor, then back
Keep your lower back down and your hips still.
Keep your other foot planted.

zh: 双膝慢慢倒向一边，两肩贴住垫子
双臂成 T 字放在垫子上。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Slowly drop both knees to one side, shoulders on the mat
Arms out in a T on the mat.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 单脚站，脚跟抬起踮到前脚掌
手扶墙保持平衡，骨盆别歪。
顶端停一下，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Stand on one foot and rise onto the ball of your foot
Hold the wall for balance and keep your hips level.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 手和脚跟推地，把屁股抬到和肩膀、膝盖一样高
手指朝向脚，手臂伸直。
胸口打开，肩胛骨往中间收。

cuesEn: Push through hands and heels and lift your hips level with your knees
Point your fingers toward your feet and keep your arms straight.
Open your chest and draw your shoulder blades together.

zh: 脚跟着地，把脚尖勾向小腿
背和屁股靠墙，腿伸直。
停一下，慢慢放下不拍地。

cuesEn: Keep your heels down and pull your toes up toward your shins
Lean your back and hips on the wall with your legs straight.
Pause, then lower slowly without slapping the floor.

zh: 手臂伸直，把毛巾往上往后抬离后背
背后双手拉紧毛巾，比髋略宽。
挺胸，上身不前倾，抬到顶停一下再放下。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and lift the towel up and away from your back
Hold a taut towel behind you, hands a little wider than your hips.
Chest up, no leaning forward. Pause at the top, then lower.

zh: 脚踩住毛巾，双手握住往上拉并停住
大臂贴身，手肘弯成直角。
保持呼吸，不要憋气。

cuesEn: Step on the towel, grip it, and pull up and hold
Keep your upper arms by your sides with elbows at a right angle.
Keep breathing and do not hold your breath.

zh: 手臂伸直，毛巾画大圈举过头再往后
两手握宽拉紧毛巾，肋骨往下收。
手肘弯了就把两手再分开些。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and arc the towel overhead and back
Hold the towel taut with a wide grip and ribs down.
If your elbows bend, widen your grip.

zh: 毛巾往两边拉紧，手肘往下往后拉
双手宽握毛巾，从头顶 V 字开始。
推回头顶时毛巾也不松。

cuesEn: Pull the towel apart and drive your elbows down and back
Hold the towel wide, starting with your arms in a V overhead.
Keep the towel tight as you press back up.

zh: 单腿站稳，另一只脚轻点前、侧、后
点地时不把重量压过去，骨盆别歪。
支撑腿膝盖微弯，对着脚尖。

cuesEn: Balance on one leg and lightly tap front, side and back
Tap without shifting your weight and keep your hips level.
Keep your standing knee soft and over your toes.

zh: 前臂贴着墙，双臂从 W 滑到 Y
后脑、后背和屁股贴墙，肋骨往下收。
滑到手肘快伸直，再慢慢滑回 W。

cuesEn: Keep your forearms near the wall and slide from a W up to a Y
Keep your head, back and hips on the wall, with your ribs down.
Slide up until your elbows are almost straight, then slowly back to the W.

zh: 后腿伸直，脚跟压地，屁股往墙靠
后脚尖正对墙，从脚跟到头一条直线。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Back leg straight, heel down, lean your hips toward the wall
Back toes point at the wall, one line from heel to head.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 后脚跟踩实，两膝微弯往前往下沉
小步前后站，双手扶墙。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Keep your back heel down and bend both knees forward and down
Short split stance, hands on the wall.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 指尖贴墙不动，慢慢抬起掌根
面向墙站稳，手臂放松，不耸肩。
抬到能控制的高度，停约 3 秒再放回。

cuesEn: Keep your fingertips on the wall and slowly lift the heel of your hand
Stand facing the wall, arm relaxed, shoulders down.
Lift as high as you can control, hold about three seconds, then lower.

zh: 手掌贴墙不动，身体慢慢转离墙面
手臂向后贴墙，和肩同高，肩膀往下沉。
停住不动，慢慢呼吸。
每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。

cuesEn: Keep your palm on the wall and slowly turn away from it
Arm back along the wall at shoulder height, shoulder down.
Stay still and breathe slowly.
Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

zh: 双腿贴墙，慢慢向两边滑开成V字
仰卧，臀部靠近墙，脚跟搭在墙上。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Keep your legs on the wall and slowly slide them apart into a V
Lie on your back with your hips close to the wall and heels resting on it.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 手掌贴墙、手指朝上，身体慢慢往后靠
双脚站稳，手肘伸直但不锁死。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，只要轻微拉伸感，别用力压墙。

cuesEn: Put your palm on the wall, fingers up, and slowly lean back
Keep your feet planted and your elbow straight but not locked.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a gentle stretch is enough, do not press hard into the wall.

actions.nameZh: 徒手单腿罗马尼亚硬拉

zh: 支撑腿微弯，上身向前倾，后腿往后抬
后腿和上身成一条直线，骨盆别歪。
手臂自然下垂，背保持平直。

cuesEn: Soften the standing knee, tip forward and let the back leg rise
Keep the back leg in line with your body and your hips level.
Let your arms hang straight down and keep your back flat.

zh: 臀部抬高别掉，脚跟慢慢推出再拉回
仰卧抬臀，脚跟踩在滑盘上。
拉回时脚跟回到膝盖下方，臀部夹紧。

cuesEn: Keep your hips high, slowly slide your heels out, then curl them back
Lie on your back, lift your hips and rest your heels on the sliders.
Pull your heels back under your knees and squeeze your glutes.

zh: 膝到头一条直线，尽量慢地往前倒
脚跟勾紧，双手护在胸前。
用大腿后侧发力，把身体拉回直立。

cuesEn: Keep a line from knees to head and lower forward as slowly as you can
Hook your heels in and keep your hands up in front of your chest.
Use the backs of your thighs to pull yourself back upright.

zh: 前臂侧撑，身体成一条直线，上面的腿抬起
上面的腿伸直，脚尖朝前不往外转。
手肘在肩膀正下方，慢抬慢放。

cuesEn: Hold a forearm side plank and lift the top leg
Keep the top leg straight with the toes pointing forward.
Keep your elbow under your shoulder and lift and lower slowly.

zh: 双腿伸直，对抗弹力带分成大V字
仰卧，双腿举到垂直，腰贴地。
分到最大停2秒，再合拢。

cuesEn: Keep your legs straight and open them into a wide V against the band
Lie on your back with your legs straight up and your lower back down.
Pause for two seconds at the widest point, then close.

zh: 靠稳椅背，膝盖外侧把垫子推开
推到最开停1秒，再慢慢收回。
双手扶住把手，身体不前后晃。

cuesEn: Sit back against the pad and push the pads out with your outer knees
Pause for one second at the widest point, then return slowly.
Hold the handles and keep your body from rocking.

zh: 身体前倾，双腿伸直抬离地面几厘米
坐在地上腿伸直并拢，双手撑在膝盖两侧。
抬起后停住，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Lean forward and lift both straight legs a few centimetres off the floor
Sit with your legs straight together and your hands beside your knees.
Hold the lift, then lower slowly.

zh: 站直扶墙，膝盖抬过髋的高度
顶端停2秒，身体别往后仰、别弯腰。
把脚放回原来的位置。

cuesEn: Stand tall with a hand on the wall and drive your knee above hip height
Hold for two seconds at the top without leaning back or bending over.
Put the foot back on its spot.

zh: 膝盖伸直，把腿抬到能控制的最高点
脚踝绑上低位绳索，身体站直。
顶端稍停，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your knee straight and raise the leg as high as you can control
Attach the ankle strap to a low cable and stand tall.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压把臀部撑起
坐在地上腿伸直，双手撑在臀部两侧。
顶端停2秒，肩膀远离耳朵。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and press your shoulders down to lift your hips
Sit with your legs long and your hands on the floor beside your hips.
Hold for two seconds at the top, shoulders away from your ears.

zh: 手臂伸直，从前面往下拉到大腿旁
下拉时肩膀往下沉，别耸肩。
底部停1秒，再慢慢回到前面。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and sweep them down to your thighs
Keep your shoulders down as you pull; do not shrug.
Pause for one second at the bottom, then return slowly.

zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压把身体顶高
放松时肩膀慢慢升向耳朵，手臂不弯。
顶端停1秒，双腿伸直并拢。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and press your shoulders down to lift your body
Let your shoulders rise slowly toward your ears without bending your arms.
Hold for one second at the top with your legs straight together.

zh: 脚踩稳，一侧膝盖慢慢往里倒
坐在椅子前三分之一，双脚比髋宽。
停一下回到中间，再换另一侧。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep your feet planted and let one knee tip slowly inward
Sit on the front third of the chair with your feet wider than your hips.
Pause, come back to center, then switch sides.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 臀部往后坐，前腿伸直，背拉长
后膝跪地，前脚跟着地、勾脚尖。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Sit your hips back, straighten the front leg and keep your back long
Kneel on the back knee with the front heel down and toes up.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 骨盆和另一条腿不动，直腿慢慢画圈
仰卧，手臂放在身体两侧，掌心贴地。
画一圈再交叉算 1 次，骨盆要转就停。

cuesEn: Keep your pelvis and other leg still while the straight leg draws slow circles
Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down.
One circle plus the cross-over counts as one. Stop before your pelvis rolls.

zh: 双脚踩稳，骨盆慢慢画大圈
双脚比髋略宽，膝盖微弯，双手叉腰。
画一圈算 1 次，每圈换方向，肩膀尽量平。

cuesEn: Keep your feet planted and draw big, slow circles with your pelvis
Stand with feet a little wider than your hips, knees soft, hands on hips.
One circle counts as one. Switch direction each time and keep your shoulders level.

zh: 夹紧臀部把大腿抬离地面，腰不拱
俯卧，一侧膝盖弯成90度，脚底朝天。
只抬起几厘米，停2秒再放下。

cuesEn: Squeeze your glute to lift the thigh off the floor without arching your back
Lie face down with one knee bent to 90 degrees, sole to the ceiling.
Lift just a few centimetres, hold for two seconds, then lower.

zh: 膝盖和骨盆贴地，小腿往两边打开
俯卧，双膝弯成90度，小腿竖直。
停一下，再慢慢回到竖直。

cuesEn: Keep your knees and pelvis down and let your shins open out to the sides
Lie face down with both knees bent to 90 degrees, shins upright.
Pause, then bring your shins slowly back up.

zh: 脚踩稳，膝盖慢慢往里倒向地面
坐地手撑在身后，手臂伸直，双脚分宽。
停一下回来，再换另一侧。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep the foot planted and let the knee drop slowly in toward the floor
Sit leaning back on straight arms with your feet wide.
Pause, come back up, then switch sides.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 身体不往后仰，大腿抬离座面几厘米
坐直，膝盖90度，双脚踩地。
停住一会儿再放下，换另一侧。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Without leaning back, lift your thigh a few centimetres off the seat
Sit tall with knees at 90 degrees and feet flat.
Hover for a moment, lower, then switch sides.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双膝夹住瑜伽砖，用力夹紧
坐直，双脚与髋同宽，手放在大腿上。
每次夹住约 5 秒，放松再夹，别憋气。

cuesEn: Squeeze the yoga block hard between your knees
Sit tall, feet hip-width apart, hands on your thighs.
Hold each squeeze about five seconds, ease off, and keep breathing.

zh: 腿伸直往侧面滑出，再用大腿内侧拉回
一只脚踩滑垫，另一侧膝盖弯、臀部往后坐。
滑到能控制的距离停住，不要硬撑。

cuesEn: Slide the straight leg out to the side, then pull it back with your inner thigh
Put one foot on the slider, bend the other knee and sit your hips back.
Stop at a distance you can control; do not force it.

zh: 胸口挺起，重心慢慢移到一只脚上
双脚约两倍髋宽，脚尖朝外，脚跟踩地。
双手在胸前合十，弯的那侧膝盖对着脚尖。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep your chest up and slowly shift onto one foot
Feet about twice hip-width, toes out, heels down.
Keep your palms together at your chest and the bent knee over the toes.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 背部拉长，上身慢慢往前倾
坐在垫子上，双腿伸直分开，脚尖和膝盖朝上。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Keep your back long and lean forward from your hips
Sit with your legs straight and wide, toes and kneecaps up.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

actions.nameZh: 仰卧单膝抱胸（托马斯测试）

zh: 双手抱住一侧膝盖，另一条腿放松贴地
看伸直那条腿的大腿会不会离开地面，离开说明髋前侧偏紧。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Hug one knee with both hands and let the other leg rest long
Watch whether the straight thigh lifts off the floor; if it does, the front of that hip is tight.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 背部拉长，双手扶椅面，上身往前倾
双脚分得很宽，脚尖朝前，膝盖伸直但别锁死。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Keep your back long, hands on the chair seat, and lean forward
Stand with your feet wide, toes forward, knees straight but not locked.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 双膝一起慢慢倒向一侧，脚踩稳
仰卧屈膝，双脚比髋略宽，手臂放两侧、掌心向下。
停一下，经过中间再倒向另一侧。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Let both knees tip slowly to one side with your feet planted
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet a bit wider than hips, arms by your sides, palms down.
Pause, then pass through the middle to the other side.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 大腿贴住椅面，小腿慢慢抬起伸直
坐稳固、没有轮子的椅子，另一只脚踩地。
伸到快直就停，膝盖别锁死。

cuesEn: Keep your thigh on the seat and slowly straighten your lower leg
Sit on a stable chair without wheels, other foot flat on the floor.
Stop just short of straight, without locking the knee.

zh: 前脚掌踩地，脚跟慢慢抬起
坐在稳固的椅子上，膝盖弯着，臀部一直坐稳。
顶端稍停，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep the balls of your feet down and slowly lift your heels
Sit on a stable chair with your knees bent and stay seated.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 先拱背低头，再挺胸抬头
坐在椅子前半部分，双脚踩地，手放膝盖上。
拱背再挺胸算 1 次，跟着呼吸慢慢做。

cuesEn: Round your back, then lift your chest
Sit near the front of the chair, feet flat, hands on your knees.
Rounding and lifting counts as one. Move slowly with your breath.

zh: 一只脚踝搭在另一侧膝盖上，背挺直往前倾
支撑脚踩平，翘起的膝盖自然往外打开。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Cross one ankle over the other knee and lean forward with a long back
Keep the other foot flat and let the crossed knee fall open.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 一条腿伸直放前面，背挺直，上身往前倾
坐在椅子前半部分，伸直那条腿脚跟着地、脚尖勾起。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Straighten one leg forward and lean forward with a long back
Sit near the front of the chair, straight leg heel down, toes up.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，脚慢慢向内摆
坐在椅子上，这只脚稍微离地，另一只脚踩稳。
小幅度慢慢摆，上身和骨盆不转。

cuesEn: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your foot slowly inward
Sit with this foot just off the floor and the other foot planted.
Move through a small range slowly, keeping your hips and body facing forward.

zh: 一只手臂举高，身体往另一侧慢慢弯
臀部坐稳，双脚踩地，另一只手臂放松垂着。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Raise one arm and slowly bend toward the other side
Keep your hips seated, feet flat, and the other arm relaxed by your side.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 坐直，身体转向一侧，手扶椅背
另一只手扶在转向那侧的膝盖外面。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Sit tall, turn to one side and hold the backrest
Put the other hand on the outside of the knee on the side you turn to.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 髋往外推，身体往椅子那边弯
离椅子远的腿交叉到后面，另一只手臂举过头顶。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Push your hip out and lean toward the chair
Cross the far leg behind and reach the other arm overhead.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

actions.nameZh: 扶椅站姿大腿后侧拉伸

zh: 前脚脚跟着地脚尖勾起，上身稍往前倾
一手扶稳椅子，支撑腿膝盖微弯。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Heel down, toes up, and lean forward a little from your hips
Hold a stable chair with one hand and soften the standing knee.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 收紧臀部，髋慢慢往前推
前后分腿站，后脚踮起，一只手扶椅背。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Squeeze your glutes and ease your hips forward
Stand in a split stance, back heel up, one hand on the chair.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

actions.nameZh: 扶椅站姿大腿前侧拉伸

zh: 手抓脚踝，把脚跟拉向臀部
单腿站直扶椅，两个膝盖并排。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Hold your ankle and draw your heel toward your glutes
Stand tall on one leg holding the chair, knees side by side.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 手臂举高，身体往另一侧弯，髋不动
双脚与髋同宽，另一只手放在大腿外侧。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Reach one arm up and bend to the other side, hips still
Feet hip-width apart, the other hand resting on the outside of your thigh.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 小腿不动，脚底慢慢向外翻
一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
在舒服的范围内翻到位，再慢慢回正。

cuesEn: Keep your shin still and slowly turn your sole outward
Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift this foot off the floor.
Turn as far as is comfortable, then come back slowly.

zh: 小腿不动，脚底慢慢向里翻
一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
小幅度翻到位，再慢慢回正。

cuesEn: Keep your shin still and slowly turn your sole inward
Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift this foot off the floor.
Turn through a small range, then come back slowly.

zh: 髋和膝不动，脚尖先绷直再勾起
一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
绷一下再勾一下算 1 次，慢慢做别憋气。

cuesEn: Keep your hip and knee still, point your toes, then pull them up
Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift this foot off the floor.
One point and one pull counts as one. Go slowly and keep breathing.

zh: 骨盆和上身一起，慢慢转开
单腿站稳，膝盖微弯，一只手轻扶椅子。
小幅度转开再转回，腰别单独扭。

cuesEn: Turn your hips and chest together, slowly opening up
Stand on one leg, knee soft, one hand lightly on the chair.
Open a little, then turn back, without twisting at the waist.

zh: 支撑腿站稳，另一侧骨盆慢慢提起
轻扶椅子，抬起的膝盖一直弯着。
小幅度提起再放平，上身别侧弯。

cuesEn: Stand firm on one leg and slowly lift the other hip
Hold the chair lightly and keep the lifted knee bent.
Lift a little, lower to level, and keep your trunk upright.

zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，小腿慢慢向外摆
站直，骨盆朝前，一只手轻扶椅子。
在舒服的范围内摆，别硬扭膝盖和脚踝。

cuesEn: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your lower leg slowly outward
Stand tall, hips facing forward, one hand lightly on the chair.
Stay in a comfortable range and do not force the knee or ankle.

zh: 大腿不动，脚跟慢慢往臀部方向抬
站直，一只手轻扶稳固的椅子。
顶端稍停，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your thigh still and slowly lift your heel toward your glutes
Stand tall with one hand lightly on a stable chair.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 身体站直，两条腿轮流慢慢抬膝
一只手扶稳椅背，另一只手自然放松。
膝盖抬到舒服的高度，再慢慢放下。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Stand tall and slowly lift one knee, then the other
Hold the chair back with one hand and relax the other arm.
Lift to a comfortable height, then lower slowly.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 臀部稍往后坐，小幅度往下蹲
双手扶稳椅背，双脚踩实不动。
膝盖对着脚尖，再踩地站起来。

cuesEn: Sit your hips back a little into a small squat
Hold the chair back with both hands and keep your feet planted.
Keep your knees in line with your toes, then push up to stand.

zh: 支撑腿膝盖微弯，背挺平身体前倾
一只手扶稳椅背，抬起的腿跟着身体往后抬。
小幅度前倾，再慢慢站直。

cuesEn: Soften the standing knee and lean forward with a flat back
Hold the chair back with one hand and let the lifted leg rise behind you.
Lean only a little, then slowly stand back up.

zh: 支撑腿微蹲，另一只脚轮流向前、侧、后点地
骨盆放平朝前，一只手轻扶椅子。
点地要轻，别把体重放到点地的脚上。
每点一次地算 1 次。

cuesEn: Bend the standing knee a little and tap front, side, then back
Keep your hips level and facing forward, one hand lightly on the chair.
Tap lightly and keep your weight off the tapping foot.
Each tap counts as one.

zh: 双手扶墙，臀部往后移，胸口往下沉
双手和胸口一样高，双脚踩稳，膝盖微弯。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Hands on the wall, push your hips back and let your chest sink
Hands at chest height, feet planted, knees soft.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 单手撑地，一条腿从身体下面穿过去
四点支撑，膝盖离地一点开始。
转身时撑地的手用力推，臀部别落地。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Push through one hand and thread one leg under your body
Start on hands and feet with your knees just off the floor.
Push the floor with the support hand as you turn and keep your hips up.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双手往前推直，身体别被拉转
侧对固定点站直，双手握住把手放在胸前。
推直后停两秒，再收回胸前。

cuesEn: Press your hands straight out and do not let your body turn
Stand tall side-on to the anchor with the handle at your chest.
Hold for two seconds, then bring your hands back to your chest.

zh: 从高处斜着往下拉到另一边髋外侧
手臂基本伸直，肩和髋一起转。
后脚跟着转，再慢慢回到高处。

cuesEn: Pull diagonally from high to outside your other hip
Keep your arms long and turn your shoulders and hips together.
Let your back foot pivot, then return slowly to the top.

zh: 膝到肩一条直线，往后倒到能控制的程度
跪直夹紧臀部，双手交叉放在胸前。
髋部别弯，整个人一起回正。

cuesEn: Keep knees to shoulders in one line and lean back only as far as you control
Kneel tall, squeeze your glutes and cross your arms on your chest.
Do not bend at the hips; come back up in one piece.

zh: 把膝盖用力伸直，大腿前侧绷紧
弹力带套在膝盖后面，膝盖微弯开始。
伸直后停两秒，脚跟不离地。

cuesEn: Straighten your knee hard and tighten the front of your thigh
Loop the band behind your knee and start with a slight bend.
Hold straight for two seconds without lifting your heel.

actions.nameZh: 器械坐姿伸腿（顶端停住）

zh: 把腿踢到完全伸直，停两秒再慢慢放
膝盖对准器械的转轴。
背靠垫子，双手扶住把手。

cuesEn: Straighten your legs fully, hold two seconds, then lower slowly
Line your knees up with the machine's pivot.
Sit back against the pad and hold the handles.

zh: 撑地的手用力推，摸肩时臀部别晃
高位平板，双脚稍微分开。
一只手抬起摸另一边肩膀，再放回。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Push the floor with the support hand and keep your hips still as you tap
Hold a high plank with your feet a little apart.
Lift one hand to tap the other shoulder, then put it back.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 手肘贴住身体，只把前臂往外打开
手肘弯成直角，肘和身体之间夹一块小垫。
慢慢放回，肩膀别耸起来。

cuesEn: Keep your elbow at your side and swing only your forearm out
Bend your elbow to a right angle with a small pad between elbow and ribs.
Return slowly without shrugging.

zh: 大臂抬平不动，只把前臂往上转到竖直
大臂和肩一样高，手肘弯成直角。
肩膀往下沉，身体别动，到顶稍停再慢慢转回。

cuesEn: Keep your upper arm level and turn only your forearm up
Upper arm at shoulder height, elbow at a right angle.
Keep your shoulder down and body still; pause at the top, then turn back slowly.

zh: 背挺直，身体朝前腿小腿上方慢慢前倾
前腿和侧腿都弯成直角，胸口对着前腿。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Keep your back long and lean forward over your front shin
Bend both knees to a right angle and face your chest over the front shin.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 脚心相对，背挺直慢慢往前倾
脚跟靠近身体，膝盖自然往两边打开。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Press your soles together and lean forward with a long back
Bring your heels in and let your knees fall open.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 脚踝搭在另一条腿的大腿上，膝盖往外打开
仰躺，踩地的脚往臀部挪一点，头和肩膀放松。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Cross your ankle over your other thigh and let the knee fall open
Lie on your back, walk the planted foot closer, and relax your head and shoulders.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 膝盖往两边打开，臀部慢慢往后坐
前臂撑地，脚尖朝外，背放平。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Spread your knees wide and slowly sit your hips back
Rest on your forearms, toes out, back flat.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 夹紧臀部，身体慢慢往前推
后膝跪地，前脚踩地，上身直立。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Squeeze your glute and slowly shift your body forward
Kneel on the back knee, front foot planted, upper body tall.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 髋部慢慢往前往下沉
前脚远远踩在前面，后膝跪地，双手扶砖。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Let your hips sink slowly forward and down
Plant your front foot far forward, kneel on the back knee, hands on the blocks.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，后腿往后伸直
双手扶砖，骨盆尽量摆正，别硬往下压。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Bring your front shin across and stretch the back leg behind you
Hands on the blocks, hips as square as you can, do not force them down.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 背挺直，身体慢慢往前折
双腿伸直并拢，脚尖朝上。
保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。

cuesEn: Keep your back long and slowly fold forward
Sit with both legs straight together, toes up.
Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.
Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

zh: 先把肩胛骨往下往后收，再抬手
趴着额头轻贴垫子，依次做 Y、T、W。
拇指朝上，手抬离垫子就放下。
每做一个字型算 1 次。

cuesEn: Pull your shoulder blades down and back before you lift
Lie face down, forehead lightly on the mat, and go Y, T, then W.
Thumbs up; lift your hands just off the mat, then lower.
Each letter counts as one.

zh: 手臂伸直，只靠肩胛骨下沉把身体抬起
正握单杠，比肩稍宽，双腿并拢。
到顶停一秒，再慢慢回到吊着的姿势。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight and lift yourself by pulling your shoulder blades down
Grip the bar overhand a little wider than your shoulders, legs together.
Hold for one second at the top, then lower slowly back to the hang.

zh: 手臂伸直，胸口先往下沉，再把地面推远
高位平板，身体一条直线。
推到顶时上背微微拱起。

cuesEn: Keep your arms straight, let your chest sink, then push the floor away
Hold a high plank with your body in one line.
At the top, let your upper back round slightly.

zh: 前臂压住泡沫轴，顺着墙往上滚
面向墙站直，两前臂平行，掌心相对。
滚到最高处，肩膀往前送一点，停一下再滑下。

cuesEn: Press your forearms into the roller and roll it up the wall
Stand tall facing the wall, forearms parallel, palms facing each other.
At the top, reach your shoulders forward a little, pause, then slide down.

zh: 推起后再往下推一点，让上背微微拱起
吊环挂低，离地十几厘米，环贴在身体两侧。
身体一条直线，慢慢下去。

cuesEn: After you press up, push a little further so your upper back rounds
Hang the rings low, about a hand span off the floor, close to your sides.
Keep your body in one line and lower slowly.

zh: 下面的手和脚撑地，身体接近水平
上面的腿抬起，另一只手向上伸直。
撑地的手推地，肩膀远离耳朵。

cuesEn: Push through your bottom hand and foot with your body almost level
Lift your top leg and reach your free arm straight up.
Push the floor away so your shoulder stays away from your ear.

zh: 撑住不落地，伸直的双腿慢慢分开再并拢
肩膀往下压，手臂伸直。
整组腿一直离地，膝盖不弯。

cuesEn: Stay up on your hands and slowly open and close your straight legs
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.
Keep your legs off the floor the whole set, knees straight.

zh: 撑住不落地，腿伸直成L撑再收回膝盖
肩膀往下压，手臂伸直。
收腿时脚跟收到身体下面。

cuesEn: Stay up on your hands, straighten your legs into an L, then pull your knees back in
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.
When you tuck, pull your heels in under you.

actions.nameZh: L 撑到 V 撑画圈

zh: 撑住不落地，双腿向外打开再往上画圈
肩膀往下压，手臂伸直。
画一圈算 1 次，每圈换方向，慢而稳。

cuesEn: Stay up on your hands, open your legs wide, then sweep them up in a circle
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.
One circle counts as one. Switch direction each circle and stay steady.

zh: 双手撑起，伸直的双腿分开离地
肩膀往下压，手臂伸直。
均匀呼吸，别憋气。

cuesEn: Press up on your hands and hold your straight legs wide off the floor
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.
Breathe steadily and do not hold your breath.

zh: 双脚不落地，腿伸直再往两边收回
双手撑在身体前面，胸口朝前。
别往后仰，慢一点做。

cuesEn: Keep your feet up, straighten your legs, then bend your knees back out to the sides
Put your hands on the floor in front of you and keep your chest facing forward.
Do not lean back; move slowly.

zh: 腿伸直，一条腿抬离地面
分腿坐直，指尖在要抬那条腿的两边点地。
腿放下停稳后，手抬起转到另一边再撑地。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep the leg straight and lift it off the floor
Sit tall in a wide straddle with your fingertips on the floor either side of the lifting leg.
Once the leg is down, lift your hands, turn to the other side and place them again.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 双腿伸直，同时抬离地面几厘米
宽分腿坐，双手在两腿之间撑地，上身前倾。
屁股不离地，停一下再放下。

cuesEn: Keep both legs straight and lift them a few centimetres off the floor
Sit in a wide straddle, hands on the floor between your legs, leaning forward.
Keep your hips down, pause, then lower.

zh: 手臂伸直推地，把屁股和双腿撑离地面
宽分腿坐，双手在两腿之间撑地。
肩膀往下压，身体前倾，撑住别落地。

cuesEn: Lock your arms and push the floor to lift your hips and legs up
Sit in a wide straddle with your hands on the floor between your legs.
Press your shoulders down, lean forward, and stay up.

zh: 肩膀往前送过手，双脚离地
蹲着双手撑地，手指稍微朝外，手臂伸直。
膝盖收在胸口下面，背微微拱起，稳住平衡。

cuesEn: Lean your shoulders past your hands and lift your feet
Crouch with your hands flat, fingers turned slightly out, arms straight.
Tuck your knees under your chest, round your back a little and hold the balance.

zh: 大腿折向胸口，双腿抬高成V字
双手撑地，肩膀往下压。
靠大腿往胸口收来抬腿，别整个人往后倒。

cuesEn: Fold your thighs toward your chest and lift your legs into a V
Support on your hands and press your shoulders down.
Lift by pulling your thighs toward your chest, not by leaning your whole body back.

zh: 手肘贴着身体往后弯，推起后伸直停一下
双手与肩同宽或稍窄。
身体一条直线，把地面推远。

cuesEn: Bend with your elbows close to your body, then press up and pause straight
Place your hands shoulder-width apart or a little narrower.
Keep your body in one line and push the floor away.

zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压、远离耳朵
脚尖先轻点地，压肩后收膝把身体撑离地面。
撑住不动，均匀呼吸，别憋气。

cuesEn: Lock your arms and press your shoulders down away from your ears
Start with your toes lightly on the floor, press your shoulders down, then tuck your knees to lift off.
Hold still and keep breathing evenly.

zh: 下到上臂差不多和地面平行，再推起
推到顶手肘伸直、肩膀往下压，停一下。
膝盖弯着，腿别甩。

cuesEn: Lower until your upper arms are about level with the floor, then press up
At the top, straighten your elbows, press your shoulders down and pause.
Keep your knees bent and do not swing your legs.

zh: 一只手和另一侧的腿伸远，身体不晃
跪撑，手在肩膀下面，膝盖在髋下面。
腿伸到髋那么高，手到肩那么高，停住再收回。

cuesEn: Reach one arm and the other leg long while your body stays still
Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach the leg to hip height and the arm to shoulder height, hold, then return.

zh: 脚跟踩地把髋往上推，顶端夹紧臀部
上背靠在稳固椅子的边缘，双脚与髋同宽，手放在髋上。
顶端大腿和身体成一条线，小腿竖直。

cuesEn: Push through your heels to lift your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top
Rest your upper back on the edge of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips.
At the top, keep your thighs and body in one line with your shins upright.

zh: 双脚并拢，上面的膝盖慢慢向上打开
侧躺，下面的前臂撑地，髋和膝弯着叠好。
骨盆别往后翻，停一下再慢慢合上。

cuesEn: Keep your feet together and slowly open your top knee
Lie on your side on your bottom forearm, hips stacked, hips and knees bent.
Do not let your hips roll back; pause, then close slowly.

zh: 下背贴地，一只手和另一侧的腿慢慢伸远
仰躺，双手指向天花板，髋和膝各弯成直角。
慢慢收回起始位，再换另一组手脚。
两边各做一次算 1 次。

cuesEn: Keep your lower back down and slowly reach one arm and the other leg long
Lie on your back, arms pointing to the ceiling, hips and knees bent at right angles.
Return slowly to the start, then switch to the other arm and leg.
One on each side counts as one rep.

zh: 脚跟踩椅面，把髋抬到肩、髋、膝一条线
仰躺，手臂放在身体两侧压地。
顶端停住，再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: With your heels on the chair, lift your hips into one line from shoulders to knees
Lie on your back with your arms by your sides pressing down.
Hold at the top, then lower slowly.

zh: 膝盖保持弯曲，腿往侧面抬起
跪撑，手在肩膀下面，膝盖在髋下面。
身体不动，停一下再慢慢放下。

cuesEn: Keep your knee bent and lift the leg out to the side
Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Keep your body still, pause, then lower slowly.

zh: 胸口微抬，伸直的手臂从头顶划到髋旁
趴着，双腿伸直，手臂离地悬空。
划到髋旁时掌心朝上，再划回头顶。

cuesEn: Keep your chest slightly lifted and sweep straight arms from overhead to your hips
Lie face down, legs long, arms hovering just off the floor.
Turn your palms up at your hips, then sweep back overhead.

zh: 背贴墙，大腿和地面平行，膝盖在脚踝上方
双脚与髋同宽，手臂向前伸直。
均匀呼吸，别憋气。

cuesEn: Back on the wall, thighs level, knees over your ankles
Feet hip-width apart, arms reaching forward.
Breathe steadily and do not hold your breath.
